topBar.noDevicesHint: Connect an iPhone or iPad with a cable and unlock it.

install.title: Install SideStore
install.description: Signed with your Apple ID, then installed over USB.

signInNeeded.title: Your Apple ID needs you to sign in again
signInNeeded.body: The saved session for {appleId} has expired. You can still install: Loadstar asks for the password when it gets there.

blocked.title: Apple blocked {appleId} on {device}
blocked.body: Apps signed with this Apple ID won't open on this device. Use another Apple ID.

sidestore.title: SideStore
sidestore.description: Refreshes and installs apps on the device by itself. Uses 2 App IDs.

livecontainer.title: LiveContainer + SideStore
livecontainer.description: Runs many apps inside one, past the 3-app limit. Uses 5 App IDs.

plan.title: This install
plan.waiting: Shown once the device and the Apple ID are ready.
plan.checking: Downloading {app} and checking with Apple… The download is kept, so the install reuses it.
plan.unavailable: Couldn't check with Apple. You can still install: each step checks again.

plan.certificatesOnTeam: {count, plural, =0 {None on the team yet} one {# on the team} other {# on the team}}

readiness.device: Available once the device is ready.
readiness.appIds: Not enough App IDs left this week.

run.subtitle: {channel} · {device} · {appleId}
run.runningHint: You can use other sections while this runs.

detail.retrying: Connection dropped. Trying again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} (attempt {attempt})

unsupportedPrompt.title: This step needs an answer
unsupportedPrompt.body: Loadstar needs an answer to a question this version can’t show. Cancel the install and update Loadstar.

report.app: {app} · {extensions, plural, =0 {no extensions} one {# extension} other {# extensions}}

session.renewed: Signed in again with the saved password

certificate.replaced: Revoked one and made a new certificate

report.signed: {count, plural, one {# bundle signed} other {# bundles signed}}

summary.title: This install
summary.appIdsValue: {count, plural, one {# left this week} other {# left this week}}

done.title: {app} is on {device}.
done.trust: On the device: Settings › General › VPN & Device Management › trust {appleId}.
done.open: Open SideStore: the pairing file and your certificate are already inside.

cancelled.title: Stopped at “{step}”.
cancelled.body: Nothing already done is repeated when you resume.

failed.continues: Finished steps are kept: trying again continues from “{step}”.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Loadstar follows your system language unless you choose one here.

locked.title: Unlock your device
locked.body: The device is locked, so Loadstar can't talk to it. Unlock it and keep it unlocked until the install finishes.

developer_mode_off.title: Developer Mode is off
developer_mode_off.body: Sideloaded apps need Developer Mode. Turn it on in Settings › Privacy & Security › Developer Mode, then restart the device.

not_paired.title: This computer isn't trusted yet
not_paired.body: Unlock the device and tap Trust when it asks whether to trust this computer.

usbmuxd_unavailable.title: Device support isn't running
usbmuxd_unavailable.body: Loadstar can't reach the system service that talks to iPhones and iPads. Install or start it, then try again.

not_found.title: No device found
not_found.body: Connect your iPhone or iPad with a USB cable and unlock it.

disconnected.title: The device was disconnected
disconnected.body: The connection dropped. Reconnect the cable, unlock the device and try again.

pairing_pending.title: Waiting for Trust
pairing_pending.body: Unlock the device and tap Trust on the prompt that appeared.

pairing_denied.title: Trust was declined
pairing_denied.body: The device declined to trust this computer. Pair again and tap Trust this time.

invalid_pair_record.title: The pairing is no longer valid
invalid_pair_record.body: The device no longer accepts this computer's pairing. Unplug it, plug it back in, unlock it and tap Trust.

service_unavailable.title: A device service didn't start
service_unavailable.body: The device refused to start a service Loadstar needs. Unlock it, reconnect it and try again.

protocol_error.title: Unexpected answer from the device
protocol_error.body: The device sent something Loadstar didn't understand. Reconnect it; if it happens again, update Loadstar or report it.

install_failed.title: The install failed
install_failed.body: The device refused to install the app. Try again; if it keeps failing, reinstall the app or report it.

afc_error.title: Couldn't transfer files
afc_error.body: Copying files to the device failed. Unlock it and try again.

timeout.title: The device stopped responding
timeout.body: The device took too long to answer. Unlock it, reconnect it and try again.

passcode_required.title: Set a passcode
passcode_required.body: This needs a device passcode. Set one in Settings › Face ID & Passcode, then try again.

free_app_limit.title: Too many sideloaded apps
free_app_limit.body: A free Apple ID can have only three sideloaded apps active on a device. Remove one, then try again.

profile_banned.title: Apple blocked this Apple ID on the device
profile_banned.body: The device won't accept apps signed with this Apple ID. Retrying won't help: use another Apple ID.

identity_invalid.title: The signing certificate is no longer valid
identity_invalid.body: The device rejected the certificate the app was signed with. Check the computer's clock, or revoke the certificate and try again.

profile_not_found.title: Provisioning profile missing
profile_not_found.body: The device couldn't find the app's provisioning profile. Try again, or reinstall the app.

anisette_unavailable.title: The anisette server isn't responding
anisette_unavailable.body: Signing in to Apple needs an anisette server, and the current one didn't answer. Choose another server or check your network.

anisette_not_provisioned.title: The anisette server isn't ready
anisette_not_provisioned.body: The anisette server couldn't set itself up. Choose another server and try again.

app_id_quota.title: No App IDs left this week
app_id_quota.body: A free Apple ID can register only 10 App IDs every 7 days. Wait for a slot to free up, or use another Apple ID.

certificate_limit.title: Too many certificates
certificate_limit.body: This Apple ID has reached its limit of development certificates. Revoke one, or use another Apple ID.

invalid_credentials.title: Wrong Apple ID or password
invalid_credentials.body: Apple didn't accept the email or password. Check them and enter the password again.

account_locked.title: This Apple ID is locked
account_locked.body: Apple locked this account for security reasons. Unlock it on an Apple device or at Apple's website, or use another Apple ID.

account_refused.title: Apple refused the sign-in
account_refused.body: Apple won't let this Apple ID sign in from here right now. Wait a while, sign in once on an Apple device, or use another Apple ID.

client_rejected.title: Apple rejected the sign-in request
client_rejected.body: Apple didn't accept the identity sent with the sign-in. Choose another anisette server, or wait and try again.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.body: Apple is limiting requests for now. Wait a few minutes and try again.

service_unavailable.title: Apple's servers are unavailable
service_unavailable.body: Apple's servers didn't respond. Wait a few minutes and check your network.

two_factor_required.title: Enter the verification code
two_factor_required.body: Apple sent a verification code to your trusted devices. Enter it to continue.

two_factor_invalid_code.title: Wrong verification code
two_factor_invalid_code.body: That code didn't work. Check it and enter it again.

two_factor_unsupported.title: This sign-in method isn't supported
two_factor_unsupported.body: This Apple ID uses a two-factor method Loadstar can't handle yet, such as a security key. Use another Apple ID.

sms_unavailable.title: Codes by text message aren't available
sms_unavailable.body: Apple won't send the code by text message here. Get it on a trusted device, or use another Apple ID.

clock_skew.title: The computer's clock is wrong
clock_skew.body: Apple rejects requests when the clock is off. Set the date and time automatically, then try again.

protocol_error.title: Unexpected answer from Apple
protocol_error.body: Apple sent something Loadstar didn't understand. Update Loadstar, or report it if it keeps happening.

session_expired.title: Your session expired
session_expired.body: Sign in to this Apple ID again. If it keeps expiring, check the computer's clock.

account_not_found.title: Apple ID not found
account_not_found.body: Loadstar has no saved session for this Apple ID. Sign in again.

not_eligible.title: This Apple ID can't be used for development
not_eligible.body: Apple doesn't allow this account to sign apps, for example because of its age or terms. Use another Apple ID.

email_unverified.title: Verify your email
email_unverified.body: Apple needs this Apple ID's email address verified first. Verify it, then try again.

team_agreement.title: Accept Apple's agreement
team_agreement.body: The team hasn't accepted Apple's latest developer agreement. Accept it at Apple's developer website, or choose another team.

no_teams.title: No developer team
no_teams.body: This Apple ID has no developer team yet. Accept Apple's developer agreement, or use another Apple ID.

device_limit.title: Device limit reached
device_limit.body: This team can't register any more devices. Choose another team, or use another Apple ID.

app_id_unavailable.title: This App ID is taken
app_id_unavailable.body: Another team already uses this App ID. Choose another team, or use another Apple ID.

invalid_app_id_name.title: Apple rejected the App ID name
invalid_app_id_name.body: Apple didn't accept the name Loadstar chose for the App ID. Update Loadstar, or report it.

certificate_not_revocable.title: This certificate can't be revoked here
certificate_not_revocable.body: Only Apple can revoke this certificate. Revoke a different one instead.

no_devices_for_profile.title: The device isn't registered yet
no_devices_for_profile.body: Apple hasn't finished registering the device. Wait a minute and try again.

developer_request_failed.title: Apple's developer services failed
developer_request_failed.body: A request to Apple's developer services failed. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.

source_gone.title: The release is no longer available
source_gone.body: The place this app was downloaded from is gone. Choose another channel, import an IPA, or update Loadstar.

unavailable.title: Couldn't load the app list
unavailable.body: Loadstar couldn't fetch the list of apps. Check your network and try again.

download_failed.title: The download failed
download_failed.body: The app couldn't be downloaded. Check your network and try again.

checksum_mismatch.title: The download is damaged
checksum_mismatch.body: The downloaded file doesn't match its checksum, so it wasn't used. Try again or choose another channel.

checksum_missing.title: The download can't be verified
checksum_missing.body: This release has no checksum, so Loadstar can't check it. Choose another channel, or import the IPA yourself.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests to GitHub
rate_limited.body: GitHub is limiting downloads for now. Wait a few minutes and try again.

invalid.title: The app's settings file is damaged
invalid.body: A property list inside the app couldn't be read. Choose another IPA, or report it.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Loadstar can't reach the internet. Check your network connection and try again.

invalid_macho.title: The app's program is damaged
invalid_macho.body: The app's executable couldn't be read. Choose another IPA.

encrypted_binary.title: The app is encrypted
encrypted_binary.body: This IPA comes from the App Store and is still encrypted, so it can't be re-signed. Choose a decrypted IPA.

unsupported_arch.title: Unsupported app format
unsupported_arch.body: The app's executable uses a format iOS can't run. Choose another IPA.

unsupported_ios.title: Needs a newer iOS
unsupported_ios.body: This app needs a newer iOS version than the device has. Update the device, or choose another channel or IPA.

unsupported_device.title: Not made for this device
unsupported_device.body: This app doesn't support this kind of device, for example an iPad-only app on an iPhone. Choose another IPA.

no_arm64_build.title: No build for iPhone or iPad
no_arm64_build.body: The app has no 64-bit build for iPhone or iPad, for example a 32-bit or simulator build. Choose another IPA.

no_header_space.title: The app can't be signed
no_header_space.body: There's no room in the app's executable for a signature. Choose another IPA, or report it.

zip_slip.title: The IPA is unsafe
zip_slip.body: The IPA tries to write files outside its own folder, so Loadstar refused it. Choose another IPA.

invalid_certificate.title: The certificate is invalid
invalid_certificate.body: The signing certificate couldn't be used. Revoke it so Loadstar can create a new one, then try again.

unknown_issuer.title: Unknown certificate issuer
unknown_issuer.body: Loadstar doesn't recognise who issued the certificate. Update Loadstar and check your network.

invalid_bundle.title: The app bundle is invalid
invalid_bundle.body: The IPA doesn't contain a valid app. Choose another IPA.

invalid_profile.title: The provisioning profile is invalid
invalid_profile.body: The provisioning profile from Apple couldn't be read. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.

extension_prefix.title: An app extension has the wrong ID
extension_prefix.body: An extension's bundle ID doesn't start with the app's own ID. Choose another IPA.

profile_mismatch.title: The provisioning profile doesn't match
profile_mismatch.body: The profile doesn't match the app it was made for. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.

profile_expired.title: The provisioning profile expired
profile_expired.body: The profile has expired, or the computer's clock is wrong. Check the clock and try again.

cert_not_in_profile.title: The certificate isn't in the profile
cert_not_in_profile.body: The provisioning profile doesn't include the signing certificate. Try again to get a fresh profile.

device_not_provisioned.title: The device isn't in the profile
device_not_provisioned.body: The provisioning profile doesn't include this device. Try again to get a fresh profile.

step_failed.title: A step failed
step_failed.body: Something went wrong during the install. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.

prompt_cancelled.title: Cancelled
prompt_cancelled.body: The install stopped because a question was cancelled. Start again when you're ready.

certificate_machine_id_missing.title: The certificate can't be shared
certificate_machine_id_missing.body: This certificate lacks the data SideStore needs to open it. Revoke it so Loadstar can create a new one, then try again.

team_required.title: Choose a team
team_required.body: This Apple ID belongs to several teams. Choose the one to sign with.

invalid_message.title: Internal communication error
invalid_message.body: Parts of Loadstar couldn't understand each other. Update Loadstar, or report it.

disconnected.title: Lost connection to the engine
disconnected.body: Loadstar's engine stopped responding. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.

timeout.title: The engine didn't answer
timeout.body: Loadstar's engine took too long to answer. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.

aborted.title: Stopped
aborted.body: The operation was stopped before it finished.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: An unexpected error happened. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.

recovery.sign-in-on-apple-device: Sign in on an Apple device
recovery.wait-for-app-id-slot: Wait for a free App ID

switchAccount.title: Use another Apple ID
switchAccount.body: The install starts again with the Apple ID you pick.

waitAndRetry.how: Apple is busy or limiting requests. Wait a minute, then try again.

checkNetwork.how: Make sure this computer is online, then try again.

checkClock.step1: Open the date and time settings on this computer
checkClock.step2: Turn on setting the date and time automatically

reEnterPassword.how: Trying again asks for the password; check it before you enter it.

reEnterCode.how: Trying again asks for a new verification code.

useTrustedDevice.how: When the code is asked for, choose a trusted device instead of a text message.

signInAgain.how: Trying again asks for the password to sign in again.

signInOnAppleDevice.how: Sign in to this Apple ID on an iPhone, iPad or Mac, or at Apple’s website, and follow what it asks:

switchAccount.how: Pick one of your saved Apple IDs. The install starts again with it.

verifyEmail.how: Verify the email address of this Apple ID at Apple’s website:

acceptAgreement.how: Sign in at Apple’s developer website and accept the agreement it shows:

revokeCertificate.how: Trying again asks which certificate to revoke.

waitForAppIdSlot.how: Apple frees each App ID 7 days after it was made. Install again once one is free, or use another Apple ID.
waitForAppIdSlot.next: The next App ID frees on {date}.

chooseAppToRemove.how: Trying again asks which app to remove to make room.

unlockDevice.how: Unlock the device and keep it unlocked until the install finishes.

trustComputer.how: Unlock the device. When it asks whether to trust this computer, tap Trust and enter the passcode.

reconnectDevice.how: Unplug the device, plug it in again and unlock it.

setPasscode.how: Set a passcode on the device in Settings › Face ID & Passcode, then try again.

installDeviceSupport.how: On Windows, install Apple Devices (or iTunes) from Microsoft Store, then restart Loadstar.

reinstallApp.how: Delete the app from the device, then try again.

chooseAnotherChannel.how: The other channel’s build may work on this device.

recovery.reportHint: Opens a new GitHub issue with the diagnostics filled in. Nothing is sent until you submit it.

engine.connected: {count, plural, =0 {Engine connected · no devices} one {Engine connected · # device} other {Engine connected · # devices}}

devices.description: iPhones and iPads connected to this computer. The one in use is shown in the top bar.

empty.title: No devices yet
empty.body: Connect an iPhone or iPad with a cable and unlock it. On Windows, Apple Devices or iTunes must be installed.

none.title: No device connected
none.body: Connect an iPhone or iPad with a cable and unlock it. It shows up here by itself.

notConnected.title: {name} isn't connected
notConnected.body: Plug it in again and it's used automatically, or pick another device in the top bar.

notTrusted.title: Trust this computer on {name}
notTrusted.body: Unlock it, tap Trust and enter the passcode.
notTrusted.titleUnnamed: Trust this computer on the device

locked.title: Unlock {name}
locked.body: It needs to stay unlocked while apps are installed.

developerModeOff.title: Turn on Developer Mode on {name}
developerModeOff.step2: Turn it on and restart when asked
developerModeOff.step3: After the restart, tap Turn On and enter the passcode

unavailable.title: Can't read {name}
unavailable.body: Unplug it and plug it in again. If it keeps happening, restart the device.
unavailable.bodyWifi: It's connected over Wi-Fi: wake it, unlock it and keep it on the same network as this computer, then Check again. A cable is more reliable.

password.title: Sign in again
password.body: The saved session for {appleId} has expired. Enter the password to continue.
password.label: Password

method.title: Where should Apple send the code?
method.body: Choose how to get your verification code.
method.trustedDeviceHint: Your iPhone, iPad or Mac signed in to this Apple ID

code.title: Enter the verification code
code.body: {length, plural, one {Enter the #-digit code Apple sent.} other {Enter the #-digit code Apple sent.}}
code.label: Verification code
code.wrong: That code didn't work. Check it and enter it again.

team.title: Which team should sign the app?
team.body: This Apple ID belongs to more than one team. Loadstar remembers your choice for this Apple ID.
team.free: Free: apps expire after 7 days, 3 apps per device
team.paid: Paid: apps last a year, no app limit

revoke.title: Revoke a certificate?
revoke.body: This team already has its maximum of development certificates, so Loadstar needs to revoke one to make its own. Apps signed with the revoked one stop refreshing.
revoke.loadstar: Made by Loadstar on another computer
revoke.sidestoreWarning: SideStore on your device stops refreshing apps until it makes a new one.
revoke.machineWarning: Xcode on that computer makes a new one the next time it signs.

remove.title: Remove an app to make room?
remove.body: A free Apple ID can have {limit} apps on a device, so one has to go before this one fits. You can install it again later.

share.title: Share your signing certificate with “{app}”?
share.body: This app looks like SideStore. With your certificate it can refresh apps on the device by itself. Only share it with an app you trust.
share.yesHint: It refreshes your apps on the device by itself
share.noHint: It is installed without your certificate

pairing.title: Which apps get the pairing file?
pairing.body: The pairing file lets an app on the device talk to it over Wi-Fi, as this computer does. Only the apps you tick get it.
pairing.available: {count, plural, one {# app on the device can use it} other {# apps on the device can use it}}
pairing.place: {count, plural, =0 {Choose an app} one {Place in # app} other {Place in # apps}}

purpose.sidestore: Refreshes and installs apps over Wi-Fi
purpose.livecontainer: Runs the apps inside it with JIT
purpose.stikstore: Installs apps from its own sources

signIn.title: Add an Apple ID
signIn.body: Loadstar signs apps with it. Your password goes only to Apple.
signIn.rememberPassword: Save my password in the system keychain
signIn.rememberPasswordHint: Lets Loadstar sign in again on its own when the session expires.

accounts.description: The Apple IDs Loadstar signs apps with. The one in use is shown in the top bar.
accounts.empty: No Apple IDs yet. Add one to install SideStore.
accounts.noTeams: Teams appear once Apple has answered.

signOut.title: Sign out of {appleId}?
signOut.forgets: Loadstar forgets this Apple ID, its session and its saved password.
signOut.keeps: Its signing certificates stay on this computer, so signing in again reuses them. Apps already installed keep working until they expire.
